title: It Was You Who Called Them
gist_ar: مشهد: بيتكشف إن كريم هو اللي بلّغ، ومقالش لسميرة.

before_listening.en: A three-person scene. One thing is revealed and one thing is deliberately not. Listen for what is REVEALED.
before_listening.ar: مشهد بين تلات أشخاص. حاجة بتتكشف وحاجة بتتحجب بإصرار. ركّز على اللي اتكشف.

segments.speaker: Samira
segments.text: It wasn't the audit that worried me. It was how calm you were about the audit.

segments.speaker: Karim
segments.text: I'm calm about a lot of things.

segments.speaker: Samira
segments.text: Not about this. What you do when something's wrong is you tidy. You alphabetise. For three weeks you didn't tidy anything.

segments.speaker: Nour
segments.text: Can I just—

segments.speaker: Samira
segments.text: No. Karim. It was you who called them.

segments.speaker: Karim
segments.text: It was me who called them.

segments.speaker: Nour
segments.text: Wait, you—

segments.speaker: Karim
segments.text: What I couldn't do was watch it happen twice. That's all it was. It wasn't loyalty to the company and it certainly wasn't courage. I did it in a car park at eleven at night and I was sick afterwards.

segments.speaker: Samira
segments.text: Why didn't you tell me?

segments.speaker: Karim
segments.text: Because what you'd have done is come with me. And then it would have been the two of us in that car park, and one of us needed to still be here in six months.

segments.speaker: Samira
segments.text: That wasn't yours to decide.

segments.speaker: Karim
segments.text: No. It's the second time this year someone has told me that.

segments.speaker: Nour
segments.text: It was Hana, wasn't it. The first time.

segments.speaker: Karim
segments.text: It was Hana.

segments.speaker: Nour
segments.text: Does she know you did it?

segments.speaker: Karim
segments.text: What Hana knows is that somebody did it, and that whoever it was waited eight months longer than she did. She hasn't asked me. I think that's deliberate.

segments.speaker: Samira
segments.text: It was her they moved to the Alexandria office, wasn't it.

segments.speaker: Karim
segments.text: It was. And what I keep coming back to is that nobody moved me anywhere. Which tells you something about how much they think I matter, and it isn't flattering.

segments.speaker: Samira
segments.text: Right. So what happens on Monday?

segments.speaker: Karim
segments.text: On Monday, nothing happens. It's what happens in March that I can't tell you about.

gist_question.q: What is revealed in this scene?
options: That the audit found nothing wrong
That Karim reported the company himself, and did not tell Samira
That Nour was the one who contacted the auditors
He was unusually calm and stopped tidying for three weeks
He alphabetised everything in the office
He was absent for three weeks

questions.q: Why does Karim say he did not tell Samira?
questions.q_ar: ليه كريم قال إنه مقالش لسميرة؟
options: She would have come with him, and one of them needed to still be there
He did not trust her to keep it quiet
She was away at the time

questions.q: What does Karim say about Monday?
questions.q_ar: كريم قال إيه عن يوم الاتنين؟
options: He is planning to resign from the company first thing on Monday morning
Nothing happens on Monday; it is March he cannot discuss
The audit result is published on Monday

questions.q: What does Karim conclude from the fact that nobody moved him?
questions.q_ar: كريم استنتج إيه من إن محدش نقله من مكانه؟
options: That the company does not consider him important
That the company has not yet noticed anything he has done at all
